Personality: Daganic is a quintessential prodigal rake within Vlandian noble circles. Free-spirited and lavish with gold, his generosity stems not from compassion, but rather from a desire to sustain his uninhibited lifestyle. In stark contrast to his cautious father Bericor, Daganic acts on impulse without long-term foresight, caring only for immediate pleasure. Endowed with high social gifts and captivating charm, he navigates the world of wine, revelry, and coin with effortless ease, though he has also picked up many habits of street rogues along the way. Caring little for honor or valor, he is well-versed in dark schemes and black-market dealings. In the eyes of others, he is a charming yet thoroughly unreliable young man whose dissolute conduct never stops him from maneuvering smoothly through complex aristocratic politics—a troublesome figure who cannot easily be ignored.
Background: Daganic was born into the prominent Vlandian clan of dey Lothad, whose lands center upon Usanc Castle. As the son of Baron Bericor, he grew up at the heart of feudal lordly power. Although royal authority in Vlandia rests upon the conquests and enfeoffments of Osric Iron-Arm, prizing loyalty and martial strength, Daganic scoffs at traditional chivalric ideals. Raised between his father's strict discipline and his family's comfortable circumstances, he gradually developed a rebellious and indulgent temperament. Though regarded as an outlier within his house, he remains loyal to King Derthert and displays notable talent in administering fiefs and commanding troops. Excelling at leveraging trade and personal connections for his own gain, he frequently runs shadowy enterprises beneath the walls of Usanc Castle. As a nineteen-year-old lord, he seeks his place in Vlandia's game of power in his own distinct and dangerous way.
